'''Rulan Allwine''' is an innkeeper in [[Market Sheran]], a village in [[Andor]].

==Appearance==
He is a stout man.

==Activities==
When [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] are making their way to [[Caemlyn]], they stop at Rulan's inn. Rand and Mat are shocked at the prices he is charging, due to the hard times. Nevertheless, they stay at his inn for the night.{{ref/book|1|33}}
